dynamic_line.no: Ah, it's you.  Mind giving your fellow American information regarding possible terrorist cyborgs?
dynamic_line.yes: Ah, yes, our cybernetic visitor.  Would you be willing to tell us more about the cyborgs that did this to you?

responses.text: You know what?  I've changed my mind.  I'll do your dirty work.  Give me some time to chat up these folks.
Please… I stopped being an American the moment the government left us to fend for ourselves.
Fine.  I'll tell you about these inter-dimensional beings.
